name: a step with an item input and a whole-list input
about: A list of 3 strings feeds both the item input of Item and List and, through Items (which makes a list of words a run, so 3 lists of 2), its whole-list input. Nested: both arrive on the same outer axis, so the step runs 3 times, each with one string and that run's 2 words. Today: the words are joined into one list of 6, and every run gets all 6.
